parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch part of a wall switch, made of ABS plastic. It is the movable component that users press to control electrical circuits.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as the actuator that toggles the electrical connection on or off when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward or outward when pressed, typically pivoting or depressing against a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the wall switch, made of polycarbonate plastic. It serves as the structural support for the switch mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the switch in place and provides mounting points for electrical connections and wall installation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.
